411: 			if qaSnapshot, qaErr := service.QAStatus(p.Name, sp.Slug); qaErr == nil {
412: 				qaSummary = qaSnapshotProjection(qaSnapshot)
413: 			} else {
414: 				mapped := mapQAUseCaseError(qaErr)
415: 				code := "qa.invalid_state"
416: 				message := "The QA state cannot be read."
417: 				guidance := "Inspect the detailed QA state and run explicit QA recovery."
418: 				if typed, ok := AsQAUseCaseError(mapped); ok {
419: 					code, message, guidance = typed.Code, typed.Message, typed.Guidance
420: 				}
421: 				qaSummary.Phase = string(sprint.QAPhaseInvalid)
422: 				qaSummary.FreshnessReasons = []string{code}
423: 				qaSummary.Blocker = &QABlockerSummary{Category: code, Scope: "state", Summary: message, NextAction: guidance}
424: 				qaSummary.NextAction = guidance
425: 			}
426: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewStatus = string(status.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus)
427: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewVerdict = string(status.Verification.Review.Verdict)
428: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewFresh = status.Verification.Review.Fresh
429: 			review := summarizeReview(status.Review)
430: 			manifest, _, manifestErr := service.PrepareReview(p.Name, sp.Slug, sprint.ReviewRequest{})
431: 			if manifestErr == nil {
432: 				review.Reviewers = summarizeReviewers(status.Review, manifest.Coverage)
433: 			} else {
434: 				review.Reviewers = summarizeReviewers(status.Review, nil)
435: 			}
436: 			for _, reviewer := range review.Reviewers {
437: 				switch reviewer.Status {
438: 				case "pending":
439: 					review.Pending++
440: 				case "running":
441: 					review.Running++
442: 				case "failed", "cancelled", "timed_out", "blocked":
443: 					review.Failed++
444: 				}
445: 			}
446: 			summary := SprintSummary{
447: 				Project:           p.Name,
448: 				Slug:              sp.Slug,
449: 				Status:            "available",
450: 				FlowStatePath:     status.FlowStatePath,
451: 				ExecutePath:       status.ExecutePath,
452: 				RunStatePath:      status.RunStatePath,
453: 				ReviewPath:        status.ReviewPath,
454: 				SmokePath:         status.SmokePath,
455: 				RefreshMayWrite:   !u.readOnly,
456: 				RefreshActionNote: "refresh derives verification freshness and assessment from current evidence without caching them as authoritative state",
457: 				Execute:           summarizeExecute(status.ExecuteState),
458: 				Review:            review,
459: 				Smoke:             summarizeSmoke(status.Smoke),
460: 				QA:                qaSummary,
461: 				Assessment:        string(status.Verification.Assessment),
462: 				NextAction:        status.Verification.NextAction,
463: 			}
464: 			if status.HistoricalExecutionStatus != "" {
465: 				summary.Status = status.HistoricalExecutionStatus
466: 				summary.Execute = summarizeHistoricalExecute(status.HistoricalExecutionStatus)
467: 			} else if executeTerminalComplete(summary.Execute) {
468: 				summary.Status = "complete"
469: 			}
470: 			summary.Review.Artifact, summary.Review.Digest, summary.Review.FreshnessReasons = status.Verification.Review.Artifact, status.Verification.Review.ArtifactDigest, append([]string(nil), status.Verification.Review.FreshnessReasons...)
471: 			summary.Review.Stale = !status.Verification.Review.Fresh
472: 			summary.Smoke.Artifact, summary.Smoke.Digest, summary.Smoke.NextAction = status.Verification.Smoke.Artifact, status.Verification.Smoke.ArtifactDigest, status.Verification.Smoke.NextAction
473: 			summary.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, summary.Smoke.Issues, summary.Smoke.Override = append([]string(nil), status.Verification.Smoke.FreshnessReasons...), append([]sprint.SmokeIssue(nil), status.Verification.Smoke.Issues...), status.Verification.Smoke.Override
474: 			summary.Smoke.Stale = !status.Verification.Smoke.Fresh
475: 			for _, stage := range status.Stages {
476: 				latestOutcome := stage.LatestOutcome
477: 				if latestOutcome == "" {
478: 					latestOutcome = string(stage.Status)
479: 				}
480: 				stageSummary := StageSummary{Name: string(stage.Stage), Status: string(stage.Status), Path: stage.Path, Error: displaySafe(stage.Error), LatestOutcome: latestOutcome}
481: 				if stage.Stage == sprint.StageCodeContext {
482: 					if info, statErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(u.root, filepath.FromSlash(stage.Path))); statErr == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
483: 						stageSummary.ArtifactAvailable = true
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				summary.Stages = append(summary.Stages, stageSummary)
487: 			}
488: 			summary.Artifacts = append(summary.Artifacts,
489: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "requirements", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageRequirements), Kind: "markdown"},
490: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "code-context", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageCodeContext), Kind: "markdown"},
491: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "sprint-index", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSprintIndex), Kind: "markdown"},
492: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "technical-handbook", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook), Kind: "markdown"},
493: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "reasoning", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReasoning), Kind: "markdown"},
494: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "plan", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StagePlan), Kind: "markdown"},
495: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "execute", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageExecute), Kind: "markdown"},
496: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "review", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReview), Kind: "markdown"},
497: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "smoke", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSmoke), Kind: "markdown"},
498: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "flow-state", Path: sprint.FlowStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
499: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "run-state", Path: sprint.ExecuteRunStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
500: 			)
501: 			for _, stage := range []sprint.PlanningStage{sprint.StageRequirements, sprint.StageCodeContext, sprint.StageSprintIndex, sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook, sprint.StageReasoning, sprint.StagePlan, sprint.StageExecute, sprint.StageReview, sprint.StageSmoke} {
502: 				result, err := validateSprintStage(service, p.Name, sp.Slug, stage)
503: 				if err != nil {
504: 					continue
505: 				}
506: 				for _, finding := range result.Findings {
507: 					summary.Findings = append(summary.Findings, sprintFinding(finding))
508: 				}
509: 				if stage == sprint.StageCodeContext {
510: 					for i := range summary.Stages {
511: 						if summary.Stages[i].Name == string(stage) {
512: 							summary.Stages[i].ArtifactValid = result.Valid()
513: 							switch {
514: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusFailed) && summary.Stages[i].ArtifactAvailable && summary.Stages[i].ArtifactValid:
515: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "A prior valid artifact is preserved; inspect the failure and explicitly rerun code-context."
516: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusFailed):
517: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Inspect the failure and explicitly rerun code-context."
518: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusComplete):
519: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Continue to sprint-index."
520: 							default:
521: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Run code-context after requirements validate."
522: 							}
523: 						}
524: 					}
525: 				}
526: 			}
527: 			sortSprintArtifacts(summary.Artifacts)
528: 			out = append(out, summary)
529: 		}
530: 	}
531: 	return out, nil
532: }

534: func sortSprintArtifacts(items []DisplayArtifact) {
535: 	order := map[string]int{"requirements": 0, "code-context": 1, "sprint-index": 2, "technical-handbook": 3, "reasoning": 4, "plan": 5, "execute": 6, "review": 7, "smoke": 8, "flow-state": 9, "run-state": 10}
536: 	sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
537: 		left, leftOK := order[items[i].Label]
538: 		right, rightOK := order[items[j].Label]
539: 		if leftOK && rightOK {
540: 			return left < right
541: 		}
542: 		if leftOK != rightOK {
543: 			return leftOK
544: 		}
545: 		return items[i].Path < items[j].Path
546: 	})
547: }

716: func (u dashboardUseCases) CancelQA(ctx context.Context, req QARequest) (QACancelResult, error) {
717: 	if u.runs == nil {

719: 	}
720: 	runID := RunID(req.RunID)
721: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {

723: 	}

726: 		return QACancelResult{}, err
727: 	}

729: 		return QACancelResult{}, fmt.Errorf("QA run does not belong to the selected sprint")

733: 		return QACancelResult{}, err
734: 	}

363: func (u dashboardUseCases) SprintSummaries(ctx context.Context) ([]SprintSummary, error) {
364: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
365: 		return nil, err
366: 	}
367: 	projects, err := project.DiscoverProjects(u.root)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return nil, mapProjectError("project.list", err)
370: 	}
371: 	service := u.sprintService()
372: 	var out []SprintSummary
373: 	for _, p := range projects {
374: 		sprints, err := sprint.DiscoverSprints(u.root, p)
375: 		if err != nil {
376: 			return nil, mapSprintError("sprint.list", err)
377: 		}
378: 		for _, sp := range sprints {
379: 			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
380: 				return nil, err
381: 			}
382: 			status, err := service.Status(p.Name, sp.Slug)
383: 			if err != nil {
384: 				qaGuidance := "Inspect sprint status and the detailed QA state before running QA recovery."
385: 				out = append(out, SprintSummary{
386: 					Project:           p.Name,
387: 					Slug:              sp.Slug,
388: 					Status:            "status unavailable",
389: 					RefreshMayWrite:   !u.readOnly,
390: 					RefreshActionNote: "refresh recomputes deterministic flow-state.json status when existing state is valid",
391: 					Findings:          []DisplayFinding{{Severity: "error", Section: "sprint.status", Problem: displaySafe(err.Error()), Suggestion: "Inspect or regenerate sprint flow-state.json outside the read-only TUI."}},
392: 					Artifacts: []DisplayArtifact{
393: 						{Label: "requirements", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageRequirements), Kind: "markdown"},
394: 						{Label: "code-context", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageCodeContext), Kind: "markdown"},
395: 						{Label: "sprint-index", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSprintIndex), Kind: "markdown"},
396: 						{Label: "technical-handbook", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook), Kind: "markdown"},
397: 						{Label: "reasoning", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReasoning), Kind: "markdown"},
398: 						{Label: "plan", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StagePlan), Kind: "markdown"},
399: 						{Label: "execute", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageExecute), Kind: "markdown"},
400: 						{Label: "review", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReview), Kind: "markdown"},
401: 						{Label: "smoke", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSmoke), Kind: "markdown"},
402: 						{Label: "flow-state", Path: sprint.FlowStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
403: 						{Label: "run-state", Path: sprint.ExecuteRunStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
404: 					},
405: 					Execute: ExecuteSummary{Message: "execute status unavailable because sprint status failed"},
406: 					QA:      QAResult{SchemaVersion: 1, Project: p.Name, Sprint: sp.Slug, Phase: string(sprint.QAPhaseInvalid), FreshnessReasons: []string{"sprint.status_unavailable"}, Blocker: &QABlockerSummary{Category: "qa.invalid_state", Scope: "state", Summary: "QA status is unavailable because sprint status could not be loaded.", NextAction: qaGuidance}, NextAction: qaGuidance},
407: 				})
408: 				continue
409: 			}
410: 			qaSummary := QAResult{SchemaVersion: 1, Project: p.Name, Sprint: sp.Slug, Phase: string(sprint.QAPhaseMissing), NextAction: "Run a QA dry run to inspect the current map."}
411: 			if qaSnapshot, qaErr := service.QAStatus(p.Name, sp.Slug); qaErr == nil {
412: 				qaSummary = qaSnapshotProjection(qaSnapshot)
413: 			} else {
414: 				mapped := mapQAUseCaseError(qaErr)
415: 				code := "qa.invalid_state"
416: 				message := "The QA state cannot be read."
417: 				guidance := "Inspect the detailed QA state and run explicit QA recovery."
418: 				if typed, ok := AsQAUseCaseError(mapped); ok {
419: 					code, message, guidance = typed.Code, typed.Message, typed.Guidance
420: 				}
421: 				qaSummary.Phase = string(sprint.QAPhaseInvalid)
422: 				qaSummary.FreshnessReasons = []string{code}
423: 				qaSummary.Blocker = &QABlockerSummary{Category: code, Scope: "state", Summary: message, NextAction: guidance}
424: 				qaSummary.NextAction = guidance
425: 			}
426: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewStatus = string(status.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus)
427: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewVerdict = string(status.Verification.Review.Verdict)
428: 			qaSummary.ConformanceReviewFresh = status.Verification.Review.Fresh
429: 			review := summarizeReview(status.Review)
430: 			manifest, _, manifestErr := service.PrepareReview(p.Name, sp.Slug, sprint.ReviewRequest{})
431: 			if manifestErr == nil {
432: 				review.Reviewers = summarizeReviewers(status.Review, manifest.Coverage)
433: 			} else {
434: 				review.Reviewers = summarizeReviewers(status.Review, nil)
435: 			}
436: 			for _, reviewer := range review.Reviewers {
437: 				switch reviewer.Status {
438: 				case "pending":
439: 					review.Pending++
440: 				case "running":
441: 					review.Running++
442: 				case "failed", "cancelled", "timed_out", "blocked":
443: 					review.Failed++
444: 				}
445: 			}
446: 			summary := SprintSummary{
447: 				Project:           p.Name,
448: 				Slug:              sp.Slug,
449: 				Status:            "available",
450: 				FlowStatePath:     status.FlowStatePath,
451: 				ExecutePath:       status.ExecutePath,
452: 				RunStatePath:      status.RunStatePath,
453: 				ReviewPath:        status.ReviewPath,
454: 				SmokePath:         status.SmokePath,
455: 				RefreshMayWrite:   !u.readOnly,
456: 				RefreshActionNote: "refresh derives verification freshness and assessment from current evidence without caching them as authoritative state",
457: 				Execute:           summarizeExecute(status.ExecuteState),
458: 				Review:            review,
459: 				Smoke:             summarizeSmoke(status.Smoke),
460: 				QA:                qaSummary,
461: 				Assessment:        string(status.Verification.Assessment),
462: 				NextAction:        status.Verification.NextAction,
463: 			}
464: 			if status.HistoricalExecutionStatus != "" {
465: 				summary.Status = status.HistoricalExecutionStatus
466: 				summary.Execute = summarizeHistoricalExecute(status.HistoricalExecutionStatus)
467: 			} else if executeTerminalComplete(summary.Execute) {
468: 				summary.Status = "complete"
469: 			}
470: 			summary.Review.Artifact, summary.Review.Digest, summary.Review.FreshnessReasons = status.Verification.Review.Artifact, status.Verification.Review.ArtifactDigest, append([]string(nil), status.Verification.Review.FreshnessReasons...)
471: 			summary.Review.Stale = !status.Verification.Review.Fresh
472: 			summary.Smoke.Artifact, summary.Smoke.Digest, summary.Smoke.NextAction = status.Verification.Smoke.Artifact, status.Verification.Smoke.ArtifactDigest, status.Verification.Smoke.NextAction
473: 			summary.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, summary.Smoke.Issues, summary.Smoke.Override = append([]string(nil), status.Verification.Smoke.FreshnessReasons...), append([]sprint.SmokeIssue(nil), status.Verification.Smoke.Issues...), status.Verification.Smoke.Override
474: 			summary.Smoke.Stale = !status.Verification.Smoke.Fresh
475: 			for _, stage := range status.Stages {
476: 				latestOutcome := stage.LatestOutcome
477: 				if latestOutcome == "" {
478: 					latestOutcome = string(stage.Status)
479: 				}
480: 				stageSummary := StageSummary{Name: string(stage.Stage), Status: string(stage.Status), Path: stage.Path, Error: displaySafe(stage.Error), LatestOutcome: latestOutcome}
481: 				if stage.Stage == sprint.StageCodeContext {
482: 					if info, statErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(u.root, filepath.FromSlash(stage.Path))); statErr == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
483: 						stageSummary.ArtifactAvailable = true
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				summary.Stages = append(summary.Stages, stageSummary)
487: 			}
488: 			summary.Artifacts = append(summary.Artifacts,
489: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "requirements", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageRequirements), Kind: "markdown"},
490: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "code-context", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageCodeContext), Kind: "markdown"},
491: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "sprint-index", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSprintIndex), Kind: "markdown"},
492: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "technical-handbook", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook), Kind: "markdown"},
493: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "reasoning", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReasoning), Kind: "markdown"},
494: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "plan", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StagePlan), Kind: "markdown"},
495: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "execute", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageExecute), Kind: "markdown"},
496: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "review", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageReview), Kind: "markdown"},
497: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "smoke", Path: sprint.ArtifactRelPath(sp, sprint.StageSmoke), Kind: "markdown"},
498: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "flow-state", Path: sprint.FlowStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
499: 				DisplayArtifact{Label: "run-state", Path: sprint.ExecuteRunStateRelPath(sp), Kind: "json"},
500: 			)
501: 			for _, stage := range []sprint.PlanningStage{sprint.StageRequirements, sprint.StageCodeContext, sprint.StageSprintIndex, sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook, sprint.StageReasoning, sprint.StagePlan, sprint.StageExecute, sprint.StageReview, sprint.StageSmoke} {
502: 				result, err := validateSprintStage(service, p.Name, sp.Slug, stage)
503: 				if err != nil {
504: 					continue
505: 				}
506: 				for _, finding := range result.Findings {
507: 					summary.Findings = append(summary.Findings, sprintFinding(finding))
508: 				}
509: 				if stage == sprint.StageCodeContext {
510: 					for i := range summary.Stages {
511: 						if summary.Stages[i].Name == string(stage) {
512: 							summary.Stages[i].ArtifactValid = result.Valid()
513: 							switch {
514: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusFailed) && summary.Stages[i].ArtifactAvailable && summary.Stages[i].ArtifactValid:
515: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "A prior valid artifact is preserved; inspect the failure and explicitly rerun code-context."
516: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusFailed):
517: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Inspect the failure and explicitly rerun code-context."
518: 							case summary.Stages[i].Status == string(sprint.StatusComplete):
519: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Continue to sprint-index."
520: 							default:
521: 								summary.Stages[i].NextAction = "Run code-context after requirements validate."
522: 							}
523: 						}
524: 					}
525: 				}
526: 			}
527: 			sortSprintArtifacts(summary.Artifacts)
528: 			out = append(out, summary)
529: 		}
530: 	}
531: 	return out, nil
532: }

534: func sortSprintArtifacts(items []DisplayArtifact) {
535: 	order := map[string]int{"requirements": 0, "code-context": 1, "sprint-index": 2, "technical-handbook": 3, "reasoning": 4, "plan": 5, "execute": 6, "review": 7, "smoke": 8, "flow-state": 9, "run-state": 10}
536: 	sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
537: 		left, leftOK := order[items[i].Label]
538: 		right, rightOK := order[items[j].Label]
539: 		if leftOK && rightOK {
540: 			return left < right
541: 		}
542: 		if leftOK != rightOK {
543: 			return leftOK
544: 		}
545: 		return items[i].Path < items[j].Path
546: 	})
547: }

565: 	case sprint.StageExecute:

584: func summarizeReview(state *sprint.ReviewStageState) ReviewSummary {
585: 	if state == nil {
586: 		return ReviewSummary{}
587: 	}
588: 	reasons := make([]string, 0, len(state.Diagnostics))
589: 	for _, diagnostic := range state.Diagnostics {
590: 		reason := diagnostic.Message
591: 		if diagnostic.Code != "" {
592: 			reason = diagnostic.Code + ": " + reason
593: 		}
594: 		reasons = append(reasons, reason)
595: 	}
596: 	summary := ReviewSummary{Available: true, Status: string(state.Status), Verdict: string(state.Verdict), Error: displayReasons(reasons), Stale: state.Stale, Completed: state.Completed, Total: state.Total}
597: 	if state.ActiveAttempt != nil {
598: 		started := state.ActiveAttempt.StartedAt
599: 		summary.StartedAt = &started
600: 	}
601: 	return summary
602: }

681: // projectRoadmap parses the project's governed roadmap and joins each entry
682: // with live sprint state when the sprint workspace exists.
683: func (u *webUseCases) projectRoadmap(projectName string, live map[string]SprintSummary) []WebRoadmapPhase {
684: 	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(u.root, "projects", projectName, "roadmap.md"))
685: 	if err != nil {
686: 		return nil
687: 	}
688: 	parsed, _ := project.ParseRoadmap(string(content))
689: 	phases := make([]WebRoadmapPhase, 0, len(parsed.Phases))
690: 	for _, phase := range parsed.Phases {
691: 		sprints := make([]WebRoadmapSprint, 0, len(phase.Sprints))
692: 		for _, item := range phase.Sprints {
693: 			entry := WebRoadmapSprint{
694: 				Number:    item.Number,
695: 				Title:     item.Title,
696: 				Slug:      item.Slug,
697: 				Status:    string(item.Status),
698: 				Goal:      item.Goal,
699: 				GateItems: append([]string(nil), item.GateItems...),
700: 				DependsOn: append([]int(nil), item.DependsOn...),
701: 			}
702: 			if state, ok := live[item.Slug]; ok {
703: 				entry.Exists = true
704: 				entry.Assessment = state.Assessment
705: 				entry.TotalStages = len(state.Stages)
706: 				for _, stage := range state.Stages {
707: 					if stage.Status == "complete" || stage.Status == "completed" || stage.Status == "skipped" {
708: 						entry.CompletedStages++
709: 						continue
710: 					}
711: 					if entry.CurrentStage == "" {
712: 						entry.CurrentStage = stage.Name
713: 					}
714: 				}
715: 			}
716: 			sprints = append(sprints, entry)
717: 		}
718: 		phases = append(phases, WebRoadmapPhase{Title: phase.Title, Sprints: sprints})
719: 	}
720: 	for i, j := 0, len(phases)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
721: 		phases[i], phases[j] = phases[j], phases[i]
722: 	}
723: 	for i := range phases {
724: 		sprints := phases[i].Sprints
725: 		for a, b := 0, len(sprints)-1; a < b; a, b = a+1, b-1 {
726: 			sprints[a], sprints[b] = sprints[b], sprints[a]
727: 		}
728: 		phases[i].Sprints = sprints
729: 	}
730: 	return phases
731: }

907: // dashboardMarkdown is a deliberately small reader for governed Markdown. It
908: // extracts useful previews while leaving the source documents authoritative.
909: type dashboardMarkdown struct {
910: 	sections map[string][]string
911: 	order    []string
912: }
913: 
914: func readDashboardMarkdown(path string) dashboardMarkdown {
915: 	result := dashboardMarkdown{sections: map[string][]string{}}
916: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
917: 	if err != nil {
918: 		return result
919: 	}
920: 	defer file.Close()
921: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64<<10))
922: 	if err != nil {
923: 		return result
924: 	}
925: 	section := ""
926: 	for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
927: 		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
928: 		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "## ") {
929: 			section = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "## ")))
930: 			result.order = append(result.order, section)
931: 			continue
932: 		}
933: 		if section != "" && line != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(line, "<!--") {
934: 			result.sections[section] = append(result.sections[section], line)
935: 		}
936: 	}
937: 	return result
938: }

940: func (m dashboardMarkdown) first(names ...string) string {
941: 	for _, name := range names {
942: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
943: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
944: 			if strings.EqualFold(heading, name) || strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
945: 				for _, line := range lines {
946: 					clean := cleanDashboardLine(line)
947: 					if clean != "" {
948: 						return clean
949: 					}
950: 				}
951: 			}
952: 		}
953: 	}
954: 	return ""
955: }

957: func (m dashboardMarkdown) items(names ...string) []string {
958: 	var out []string
959: 	for _, name := range names {
960: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
961: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
962: 			if !strings.EqualFold(heading, name) && !strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
963: 				continue
964: 			}
965: 			for _, line := range lines {
966: 				if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "* ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "1. ") {
967: 					if value := cleanDashboardLine(line); value != "" {
968: 						out = append(out, value)
969: 					}
970: 				}
971: 			}
972: 		}
973: 	}
974: 	return out
975: }

977: func cleanDashboardLine(line string) string {
978: 	line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
979: 	line = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "- "), "* "), "1. ")
980: 	line = strings.Trim(line, "`*# ")
981: 	if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.Contains(line, "]:") {
982: 		line = strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(line, "]:", 2)[1])
983: 	}
984: 	return line
985: }

988: 	return len(m.items(names...))

681: // projectRoadmap parses the project's governed roadmap and joins each entry
682: // with live sprint state when the sprint workspace exists.
683: func (u *webUseCases) projectRoadmap(projectName string, live map[string]SprintSummary) []WebRoadmapPhase {
684: 	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(u.root, "projects", projectName, "roadmap.md"))
685: 	if err != nil {
686: 		return nil
687: 	}
688: 	parsed, _ := project.ParseRoadmap(string(content))
689: 	phases := make([]WebRoadmapPhase, 0, len(parsed.Phases))
690: 	for _, phase := range parsed.Phases {
691: 		sprints := make([]WebRoadmapSprint, 0, len(phase.Sprints))
692: 		for _, item := range phase.Sprints {
693: 			entry := WebRoadmapSprint{
694: 				Number:    item.Number,
695: 				Title:     item.Title,
696: 				Slug:      item.Slug,
697: 				Status:    string(item.Status),
698: 				Goal:      item.Goal,
699: 				GateItems: append([]string(nil), item.GateItems...),
700: 				DependsOn: append([]int(nil), item.DependsOn...),
701: 			}
702: 			if state, ok := live[item.Slug]; ok {
703: 				entry.Exists = true
704: 				entry.Assessment = state.Assessment
705: 				entry.TotalStages = len(state.Stages)
706: 				for _, stage := range state.Stages {
707: 					if stage.Status == "complete" || stage.Status == "completed" || stage.Status == "skipped" {
708: 						entry.CompletedStages++
709: 						continue
710: 					}
711: 					if entry.CurrentStage == "" {
712: 						entry.CurrentStage = stage.Name
713: 					}
714: 				}
715: 			}
716: 			sprints = append(sprints, entry)
717: 		}
718: 		phases = append(phases, WebRoadmapPhase{Title: phase.Title, Sprints: sprints})
719: 	}
720: 	for i, j := 0, len(phases)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
721: 		phases[i], phases[j] = phases[j], phases[i]
722: 	}
723: 	for i := range phases {
724: 		sprints := phases[i].Sprints
725: 		for a, b := 0, len(sprints)-1; a < b; a, b = a+1, b-1 {
726: 			sprints[a], sprints[b] = sprints[b], sprints[a]
727: 		}
728: 		phases[i].Sprints = sprints
729: 	}
730: 	return phases
731: }

790: 			result.RunStages = sprintRunStages(item)

809: func (u *webUseCases) PromptBundle(ctx context.Context, project, slug, stageName string) (WebPromptBundleResult, error) {
810: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
811: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, err
812: 	}
813: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(stageName)
814: 	result := WebPromptBundleResult{
815: 		Stage:         stage,
816: 		Scope:         "Deterministic stage preview",
817: 		InputContract: sprint.InputContract(stage),
818: 	}
819: 	service := u.dashboard.sprintService()
820: 	var (
821: 		preview sprint.PromptPreview
822: 		err     error
823: 	)
824: 	switch stage {
825: 	case sprint.StageRequirements:
826: 		preview, err = service.PromptRequirements(project, slug)
827: 	case sprint.StageCodeContext:
828: 		preview, err = service.PromptCodeContext(project, slug)
829: 	case sprint.StageSprintIndex:
830: 		preview, err = service.PromptSprintIndex(project, slug)
831: 	case sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook:
832: 		preview, err = service.PromptTechnicalHandbook(project, slug)
833: 	case sprint.StageAreaReasoning:
834: 		result.Scope = "First selected area prompt"
835: 		preview, err = service.PromptAreaReasoning(project, slug)
836: 	case sprint.StageReasoning:
837: 		preview, err = service.PromptReasoning(project, slug)
838: 	case sprint.StagePlan:
839: 		preview, err = service.PromptPlan(project, slug)
840: 	case sprint.StageExecute:
841: 		result.Scope = "One session for the ordered task queue"
842: 		preview, err = service.PromptExecute(project, slug, sprint.ExecuteRequest{})
843: 	case sprint.StageReview:
844: 		result.Scope = "Conformance Review manifest preview; worker suffixes vary"
845: 		preview, err = service.PromptReview(project, slug, sprint.ReviewRequest{})
846: 	case sprint.StageSmoke:
847: 		result.Scope = "Prepared after smoke harness discovery"
848: 		result.UnavailableReason = "The smoke prompt is assembled only after the governed harness and acceptance coverage are discovered."
849: 		return result, nil
850: 	default:
851: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, ErrWebNotFound
852: 	}
853: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
854: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, err
855: 	}
856: 	if err != nil {
857: 		result.UnavailableReason = displaySafe(err.Error())
858: 		return result, nil
859: 	}
860: 	explanation := preview.Explanation
861: 	if explanation == nil {
862: 		value := sprint.ExplainPrompt(preview.Prompt)
863: 		explanation = &value
864: 	}
865: 	contract := result.InputContract
866: 	explanation.InputContract = &contract

907: // dashboardMarkdown is a deliberately small reader for governed Markdown. It
908: // extracts useful previews while leaving the source documents authoritative.
909: type dashboardMarkdown struct {
910: 	sections map[string][]string
911: 	order    []string
912: }
913: 
914: func readDashboardMarkdown(path string) dashboardMarkdown {
915: 	result := dashboardMarkdown{sections: map[string][]string{}}
916: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
917: 	if err != nil {
918: 		return result
919: 	}
920: 	defer file.Close()
921: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64<<10))
922: 	if err != nil {
923: 		return result
924: 	}
925: 	section := ""
926: 	for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
927: 		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
928: 		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "## ") {
929: 			section = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "## ")))
930: 			result.order = append(result.order, section)
931: 			continue
932: 		}
933: 		if section != "" && line != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(line, "<!--") {
934: 			result.sections[section] = append(result.sections[section], line)
935: 		}
936: 	}
937: 	return result
938: }

940: func (m dashboardMarkdown) first(names ...string) string {
941: 	for _, name := range names {
942: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
943: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
944: 			if strings.EqualFold(heading, name) || strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
945: 				for _, line := range lines {
946: 					clean := cleanDashboardLine(line)
947: 					if clean != "" {
948: 						return clean
949: 					}
950: 				}
951: 			}
952: 		}
953: 	}
954: 	return ""
955: }

957: func (m dashboardMarkdown) items(names ...string) []string {
958: 	var out []string
959: 	for _, name := range names {
960: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
961: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
962: 			if !strings.EqualFold(heading, name) && !strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
963: 				continue
964: 			}
965: 			for _, line := range lines {
966: 				if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "* ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "1. ") {
967: 					if value := cleanDashboardLine(line); value != "" {
968: 						out = append(out, value)
969: 					}
970: 				}
971: 			}
972: 		}
973: 	}

977: func cleanDashboardLine(line string) string {
978: 	line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
979: 	line = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "- "), "* "), "1. ")
980: 	line = strings.Trim(line, "`*# ")
981: 	if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.Contains(line, "]:") {
982: 		line = strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(line, "]:", 2)[1])
983: 	}

97: func (m *durableOperationManager) AcceptOperation(ctx context.Context, confirmation Confirmation, digest string) (AcceptedOperation, error) {
98: 	req := confirmation.Request
99: 	target := runcontrol.Target{
100: 		Kind: "operation", Operation: string(req.Kind), Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint,
101: 		Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage, Task: req.Task,
102: 	}
103: 	snapshot, err := m.repository.Accept(ctx, runcontrol.Acceptance{
104: 		Target: target, ProductStatus: "prepared", OperationAlias: digest, ConfirmationDigest: digest,
105: 	})
106: 	if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict) {
107: 		existing, resolveErr := m.repository.ResolveOperationAlias(ctx, digest)
108: 		if resolveErr != nil {
109: 			return AcceptedOperation{}, errors.Join(err, resolveErr)
110: 		}
111: 		return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(existing.RunID), Context: ctx, Existing: true, Lifecycle: string(existing.Lifecycle)}, nil
112: 	}
113: 	if err != nil {
114: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w", err)
115: 	}
116: 	attempt, _, err := m.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: m.owner, Lease: runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration})
117: 	if err != nil {
118: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation owner claim: %w", err)
119: 	}
120: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: m.owner.ID, FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration}
121: 	if _, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
122: 		Type: runcontrol.EventLifecycle, Lifecycle: runcontrol.LifecycleRunning,
123: 		Payload: map[string]string{"lifecycle": string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)},
124: 	}); err != nil {
125: 		terminalCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
126: 		_, _, _ = proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "operation start persistence failed", ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
127: 		cancel()
128: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation start: %w", err)
129: 	}
130: 	operationCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(runcontrol.WithParentRun(ctx, snapshot.RunID))
131: 	operationCtx = context.WithValue(operationCtx, durableOperationContextKey{}, durableOperationOwnership{repository: m.repository, fence: fence})
132: 	owned := &ownedDurableOperation{fence: fence, cancel: cancel, stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
133: 	m.mu.Lock()
134: 	m.owned[string(snapshot.RunID)] = owned
135: 	m.mu.Unlock()
136: 	go m.controlOperation(operationCtx, owned)

140: func qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx context.Context) (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
141: 	ownership, ok := ctx.Value(durableOperationContextKey{}).(durableOperationOwnership)
142: 	if !ok || ownership.repository == nil {
143: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is missing from the operation context")
144: 	}
145: 	token := sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID: string(ownership.fence.RunID), OperationalAttemptID: string(ownership.fence.AttemptID), FencingGeneration: ownership.fence.FencingGeneration}

153: 		return err

158: func (m *durableOperationManager) RecordOperationEvent(ctx context.Context, runID string, event OperationEvent) (bool, error) {
159: 	m.mu.Lock()
160: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
161: 	m.mu.Unlock()
162: 	if owned == nil {
163: 		return false, runcontrol.ErrNotFound
164: 	}
165: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
166: 	defer owned.eventMu.Unlock()
167: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
168: 	if event.State == OperationFailed {
169: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
170: 	}
171: 	key := string(eventType) + "\x00" + event.Stage + "\x00" + event.Task + "\x00" + event.PhaseState + "\x00" + event.SafeSummary + "\x00" + event.EventType + "\x00" + event.EventKind + "\x00" + event.Tool + "\x00" + event.Reason + "\x00" + event.Detail

173: 	elapsed := now.Sub(owned.progressAt)
174: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == owned.progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
175: 		if owned.omitted == 0 {
176: 			owned.omittedFirst = now
177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++
179: 		owned.omittedLast = now
180: 		return false, nil
181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),
185: 	}
186: 	for key, value := range map[string]string{
187: 		"phase_state": event.PhaseState, "summary": event.SafeSummary,
188: 		"tool_call_id": event.ToolCallID, "tool_status": event.ToolStatus,
189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,
191: 	} {
192: 		if value != "" {
193: 			payload[key] = value
194: 		}
195: 	}
196: 	var omission *runcontrol.Omission
197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()
215: 		return false, err
216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil

223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return
247: 			}
248: 			if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()
251: 					return
252: 				}
253: 				lastHeartbeat = now
254: 			}
255: 			if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
256: 				if _, err := m.repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}
260: 				lastReconcile = now
261: 			}
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: }

267: 	m.mu.Lock()
268: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}
274: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}
282: 	owned.eventMu.Unlock()
283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:
294: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalFailed, "operation failed"
295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"
297: 	}
298: 	_, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})

80: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("operation capability unavailable"))
81: 		return
82: 	}
83: 	if h.hub.isDraining() {
84: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errServerDraining)
85: 		return
86: 	}
87: 	var payload prepareRequest
88: 	if err := decodeStrictJSON(r, &payload); err != nil {
89: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
90: 		return
91: 	}
92: 	req, err := mapOperationRequest(payload.Operation)
93: 	if err != nil {
94: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
95: 		return
96: 	}
97: 	confirmation, err := h.hub.ops.PrepareOperation(r.Context(), req)
98: 	if err != nil {
99: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
100: 		return
101: 	}
102: 	record, err := h.preparations.issue(sessionID(r.Context()), confirmation)
103: 	if err != nil {
104: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
105: 		return
106: 	}
107: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_prepared", "", string(confirmation.Request.Kind), "prepared", "")
108: 	dto := preparationDTO{
109: 		PreparationID: record.ID, Operation: mapOperationSpec(confirmation.Request), AffectedPaths: append([]string(nil), confirmation.Paths...),
110: 		MutationClass: confirmation.MutationClass, Prerequisites: append([]string(nil), confirmation.Prerequisites...),
111: 		InputFingerprint: confirmation.InputFingerprint, ExpiresAt: record.ExpiresAt, ConfirmationToken: record.Token,
112: 	}
113: 	if confirmation.Runtime {
114: 		dto.Runtime = runtimeConfirmationDTO(confirmation)
115: 	}
116: 	if confirmation.Request.Kind == app.OperationSmokeStart || confirmation.Request.Kind == app.OperationSmokeDryRun {
117: 		dto.Harness = map[string]any{"kind": "configured_smoke_harness"}
118: 	}
119: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, dto, nil)
120: }

185: func (h *handler) handleActiveOperations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
186: 	operations := h.hub.activeOperations(sessionID(r.Context()))
187: 	if h.runs != nil {
188: 		page, err := h.runs.Runs(r.Context(), app.RunQuery{Lifecycle: []app.RunLifecycle{"accepted", "queued", "running", "cancelling"}, TargetKind: "operation", Limit: 200})
189: 		if err == nil {
190: 			seen := make(map[string]bool, len(operations))
191: 			for _, operation := range operations {
192: 				seen[operation.ID] = true
193: 			}
194: 			for _, snapshot := range page.Runs {
195: 				if seen[string(snapshot.RunID)] || !snapshot.Lifecycle.IsActive() || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
196: 					continue
197: 				}
198: 				operations = append(operations, durableActiveOperation(snapshot))
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: 	count := len(operations)
203: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, operations, &app.CollectionInfo{ReturnedCount: count, TotalCount: count})

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

541: 	}

555: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
556: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
557: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
558: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
559: 		return ""
560: 	}
561: 	for _, r := range number {
562: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
563: 			return number + "-" + name
564: 		}
565: 	}
566: 	var slug strings.Builder

185: func (h *handler) handleActiveOperations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

191: 			for _, operation := range operations {
192: 				seen[operation.ID] = true

194: 			for _, snapshot := range page.Runs {
195: 				if seen[string(snapshot.RunID)] || !snapshot.Lifecycle.IsActive() || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
196: 					continue
197: 				}
198: 				operations = append(operations, durableActiveOperation(snapshot))
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: 	count := len(operations)
203: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, operations, &app.CollectionInfo{ReturnedCount: count, TotalCount: count})

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

555: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
556: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
557: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
558: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
559: 		return ""
560: 	}
561: 	for _, r := range number {
562: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
563: 			return number + "-" + name
564: 		}
565: 	}
566: 	var slug strings.Builder
567: 	separator := false
568: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
569: 		switch {
570: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
571: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
572: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
573: 			}
574: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
575: 			separator = false
576: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
577: 			separator = true
578: 		default:
579: 			return number + "-" + name
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
583: 		return ""
584: 	}
585: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
586: }

593: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
594: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
595: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
596: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
597: 	}
598: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
599: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
600: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
601: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
602: 	}
603: 	var extra any
604: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
605: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
606: 	}
607: 	return nil
608: }

610: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
611: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
612: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
613: 	}
614: 	options := spec.Options
615: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
616: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
617: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
618: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
619: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
620: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
621: 	}
622: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
623: 	switch kind {
624: 	case "validation", "validate":
625: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
626: 	case "sprint-status":
627: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
628: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
629: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
630: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":
631: 		req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
632: 	case "sprint-flow":
633: 		if options.DryRun {
634: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
635: 		} else {
636: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlow
637: 		}
638: 	case "sprint-stage":
639: 		if options.DryRun {
640: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
641: 		} else {
642: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStage
643: 		}
644: 	case "sprint-stage-dry-run":
645: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
646: 	case "execute", "execute-start":
647: 		switch {
648: 		case options.Action == "status":
649: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
650: 		case options.DryRun:
651: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
652: 		case options.Resume:
653: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
654: 		default:
655: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStart
656: 		}
657: 	case "execute-status":
658: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
659: 	case "execute-dry-run":
660: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
661: 	case "execute-resume":
662: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
663: 	case "review", "review-start":
664: 		if options.Action == "status" {
665: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
666: 		} else if options.DryRun {
667: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
668: 		} else {
669: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStart
670: 		}
671: 	case "review-status":
672: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
673: 	case "review-dry-run":
674: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
675: 	case "smoke", "smoke-start":

Run all current shards or one map-owned shard, then inspect status:

```bash
ultraplan sprint <project> <sprint> qa
ultraplan sprint <project> <sprint> qa --shard qa-v1-shard-...
ultraplan sprint <project> <sprint> qa status
```

Investigators can only read assigned paths and request bounded context or approved non-mutating checks. They cannot create tests, fixtures, probes, patches, issues, or repairs. A theory is a falsifiable diagnostic record: `confirmed` supports its claim, `refuted` rejects it, `invalid` means the claim contract failed, `inconclusive` lacks safe evidence, `blocked` records a prerequisite or policy stop, `cross_shard` needs bounded interaction work, and `not_applicable` records that the claim does not apply. Negative outcomes remain visible.

Cancellation is explicit and uses the durable run ID shown by status and run inspection:

```bash
ultraplan sprint <project> <sprint> qa cancel --run run_...
```

After cancellation, timeout, restart, or restored runtime availability, first inspect status. Use `qa recover` to reconcile runtime-free state and `qa resume` to claim incomplete current work with a new durable owner. Completed current shards are retained; changed map or input fingerprints make the attempt stale and require a new dry-run/start. `Read-only QA completed` means all admitted bounded work ended, not “QA passed,” and it cannot upgrade a failed or blocked Conformance Review.

Sprint planning prompts are markdown defaults embedded in the CLI, not hand-built Go checklist strings. A workspace can override them by installing defaults and editing files such as `prompts/create-requirements.md`, `prompts/create-sprint-index.md`, `prompts/create-technical-handbook.md`, `prompts/create-sprint-reasoning.md`, or `prompts/plan-sprint.md`. A project may override only the area-reasoning prompt, final-reasoning prompt, and final-reasoning template. Project status reports which source is effective.

The materialised stage skills are interactive forms of those prompts. Invoke
them explicitly as `$ultraplan-requirements`, `$ultraplan-code-context`,
`$ultraplan-sprint-index`, `$ultraplan-technical-handbook`,
`$ultraplan-area-reasoning`, `$ultraplan-reasoning`, `$ultraplan-plan`,
`$ultraplan-execute`, `$ultraplan-review`, or `$ultraplan-smoke`. A skill
checks status and validates prerequisites first. If gaps exist, it must ask
before filling them. Unless the user requests a proposal or discussion only,
the skill performs the selected stage and reconciles status afterward.

For area and final reasoning, an explicit deep-dive request should become an
interactive design discussion covering evidence, alternatives, trade-offs,
risks, technical debt, and future consequences before conclusions are written.
See [Manually Invoked Stage Skills](stage-skills.md) for the complete contract.
## Watching and controlling durable runs

Every runtime-backed CLI command, confirmed web/TUI operation, and external
smoke execution receives a durable run before work starts. Use `ultraplan run
list` or the web/TUI Runs view to find it. The same ID, lifecycle, liveness,
cancellation state, product status, retention state, and event cursor are shown
on every surface.

Lifecycle answers what the operation has durably decided; liveness answers
whether its current owner is known to be running. Product status is separate.
For example, `running / stalled / product unknown` is meaningful and must not
be displayed as success. Likewise, a cancellation request can lose the
immutable terminal race to a completion that had already committed.

Use `run follow` for observation and `run cancel` for control. Closing a tab,
leaving a TUI view, quitting the TUI, or interrupting `run follow` does not
cancel work. A compacted or tombstone record remains truthful about its current
snapshot even when full event history is no longer available.

## Durable run commands

All commands operate on the selected workspace (`--workspace` or normal
discovery) and do not contact a provider.

```text
ultraplan run list [--project <ref>] [--sprint <ref>] [--study <ref>]
                   [--lifecycle <comma-list>] [--limit <1..200>]
                   [--after <cursor>] [--json]
ultraplan run show <run-id> [--json]
ultraplan run follow <run-id> [--after <sequence>] [--json]
ultraplan run cancel <run-id> [--reason user_requested] [--json]
ultraplan run diagnostics [--json] [--support-export <file>]
```

`list` is newest-first, defaults to 50 records, and returns an opaque pagination
cursor. Active means only `accepted`, `queued`, `running`, or `cancelling`.
`follow` replays committed events, polls quickly while catching up and at most
once per second while idle. Interrupting follow stops observation only; use
`cancel` for an explicit durable cancellation command. Cancellation is
idempotent and does not overwrite an already-terminal winner.

Diagnostics reports schema/WAL, quota, retention, active/stalled ownership, and
reconciliation backlog. `--support-export` creates a private, bounded file (at
most 1 MiB) containing safe snapshots, event headers/omission facts, health,
config source classes, reconciliation decisions, and the newest sanitized
records from `.ultraplan/run-control.log`; it excludes event payloads, prompts,
provider data, source content, credentials, arbitrary output, and the absolute
workspace path.

The command lifecycle is:

1. `POST /api/v1/operations/prepare` performs side-effect-free normalization,
   prerequisite inspection, affected-path projection, and fingerprinting.
2. The user reviews the returned scope and short-lived confirmation.
3. `POST /api/v1/operations` repeats the specification, re-normalizes it, and
   starts server-owned work only if the confirmation remains current. Success
   is `202` with a `Location` header. Retrying the same accepted session/token
   returns the original operation and Location without starting duplicate work.
4. `GET /api/v1/operations` returns the current browser session's active
   operations. The navigation uses this bounded, ephemeral collection to
   recover links to work after a page change or refresh; it never exposes
   another session's operations or treats the collection as durable state.

   idempotent.

`cancelled`, `interrupted`, and `cleanup_uncertain`. Stable SSE event names are
`snapshot`, `progress`, `warning`, `finding`, `artifact`, `cancel_requested`,

1. ActionConfirm is defined and handled but produced by no key binding; confirmation flows exclusively through ActionOpen's first precedence slot. Intent (reserved future binding vs leftover) is undocumented in-tree.

Study-cancel issued via the `c` ladder bypasses PrepareOperation/AcceptOperation entirely (constructed directly at app.go:139; beginOperation's durable branch requires Confirmation != nil), and because ActiveRunID stays empty, pressing `c` again takes the local-context lane rather than any durable lane. # Context Pack: `shared-usecase-vocabulary` — Cross-interface operation vocabulary and parity

Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: operator-interfaces. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

The convergence fabric behind CLI, TUI, and web: one typed operation vocabulary (`OperationKind`, 27 constants), one prepare→confirm→accept→run pipeline (`PrepareOperation`/`RunOperation` plus the optional `DurableOperationManager`), one shared runtime-backed executor (`sharedOperationRunner`), and one durable landing format (run-control rows whose `Target.Operation` stores the kind string; dedup keys stored in the `operation_aliases` table and `confirmation_digest` column). Three structurally different acceptance-digest regimes (web session+token hash, TUI content hash, CLI empty) feed the same alias column. Cancellation reasons and cancel-time target checks differ per door before converging on `RequestCancellation`. Read-only composition is split: web composes `readOnly=true`, TUI leaves it false. Durable-event replay/polling exists as three structurally similar Go loops plus an SSE/in-memory replay pair.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Vocabulary core (`internal/app/operations.go`)
- `OperationKind` constants :74-102 (27): `validate`, `sprint-status`, `sprint-prompt`, `sprint-flow-dry-run`, `sprint-flow`, `sprint-stage-dry-run`, `sprint-stage`, `execute-status`, `execute-dry-run`, `execute-start`, `execute-resume`, `review-status`, `review-dry-run`, `review-start`, `smoke-status`, `smoke-dry-run`, `smoke-start`, `verify-dry-run`, `verify-start`, `qa-status`, `qa-dry-run`, `qa-start`, `qa-resume`, `qa-recover`, `study-start`, `study-resume`, `study-cancel`.
- `OperationState` :104-113: preparing/running/complete/failed/cancelled/partial.
- Capability interfaces: `ReadOnlyUseCases` (Dashboard, PreviewArtifact; usecases.go:24-27), `WebOperations` (Validate/PrepareOperation/RunOperation; operations.go:32-36), union `OperationalUseCases` :25-28 consumed by the TUI, optional `DurableOperationManager` :41-45 (AcceptOperation/RecordOperationEvent/FinishOperation returning `AcceptedOperation{RunID, Context, Existing, Lifecycle}`), optional `OperationCleanupRecorder` :57-59 and `OperationReconciler` :68-70 (web drain/recovery), `RunUseCases` (Runs/Run/RunEvents/CancelRun/RunHealth; run_usecases.go:29-35). `dashboardUseCases` (usecases.go:61-71) carries root, runner func, stageRuntime, reviewConcurrency, smoke/qa settings, `readOnly`, runs, durable.

### 2.2 Prepare (`dashboardUseCases.PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-358)
Strips caller-supplied `ExpectedFingerprint` (:215, server authority per comment :129-132), normalizes fields/lists (:523-539, lists trimmed/deduped/sorted :559-575), validates scope identifiers ([A-Za-z0-9._-], ≤128, no `/\\`, not `.`/`..`; :541-557) and QA field lockdown (project/sprint/map-owned shard only; :361-374). Review start/dry-run default Parallelism from configured review concurrency (:223-225). Per-kind Confirmation population (:227-319): runtime-free classes get warning text; QA dry-run/start/resume call `QAMap` and admit only map-owned shards; sprint-status is declared mutating ("MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"); smoke dry-run/start run a real `RunSmoke(DryRun:true)` preview to fill scope/prereqs/timeout source. Paths + web refresh hints (:320-331), `MutationClass` ∈ read_only/sprint_mutation/study_mutation (:332-340), `ModelSource` via stage-runtime lookup (:341-343, 603-625), prerequisites (:586-601). Canonical form = `json.Marshal(req)` with fingerprint field cleared (:577-584); fingerprint basis = canonical + `\nruntime=` ModelSource + `\nscope=` joined Scope (:351); `InputFingerprint` = sha256 over governed-input files (`governedOperationInputs` :627-661 — ultraplan.yml, project/sprint artifacts, QA adds execute/review/run-state/flow-state; studies add study.yml/yaml/run-state; missing entries skipped, symlinks rejected incl. inside dir walks, sorted walk order; :663-718).

### 2.3 Run dispatch (`dashboardUseCases.RunOperation`, operations.go:376-521)
Clears expected, re-prepares fresh (:377-386); non-empty expected ≠ fresh fingerprint → `ErrStaleOperation` (:383-385, sentinel :209). Emits running event; in-process switch handles runtime-free kinds (validate, sprint-status, prompt, flow/stage/execute dry-runs and status, review status/dry-run, smoke status/dry-run, qa status/dry-run/recover, verify dry-run) against sprint/study/project services; all other kinds delegate to `u.runner` (nil → "runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition" :513-517). Terminal complete event emitted :519.

### 2.4 Shared runtime executor (`sharedOperationRunner`, operation_runner.go:18-168)
Single implementation wired into both serve (serve_commands.go:79) and tui (tui_commands.go:53). Maps: OperationStage/Flow → FlowStage/runSprintFlow with model override plumbing (`stageFlowRequest` :175-188); ExecuteStart/Resume → Execute(TaskID, ModelOverride, Resume); ReviewStart → Review(Concurrency/Focus/Restart/ModelOverride, progress events); SmokeStart → RunSmoke with parsed timeout (parse errors silently yield 0) and post-hoc artifact preview; VerifyStart → Verify; QAStart/QAResume → extracts writer token+fence from the durable operation context value (`qaOwnershipFromContext`, durable_operations.go:140-156) and applies `WithQAWriterFence`; StudyStart/StudyResume → runLoopService + RunLoop with parallelism/model and stats-rich progress events (`applyRuntimeObservation` operations.go:163-194 merges provider/tool observations); StudyCancel → ListStudy + `study.CancelRunLoop` (SIGINT to lock-PID lane, message reports PID :152-162). ### 2.6 Acceptance digest regimes (three doors, one alias column)
- **Web**: prepare issues a `preparationStore` record bound to (session, CanonicalRequest, InputFingerprint) with 2-min TTL, ≤128 records, typed replay/expiry/mismatch/stale errors (security.go:368-446). Start re-prepares then consumes the token inside the hub callback; dedup key = sha256(session+"\x00"+confirmationToken) hex (security.go:448-451); `startConfirmed` checks in-memory `h.dedup` first (same-session only; stale mapping deleted), enforces draining/capacity, then calls `AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)` (operations.go:150-218). Alias hit returns doc {ID=existing run id, State=accepted.Lifecycle, RefreshPath=/runs/<id>} without starting work (:193-198). If the use cases lack the durable capability (`ErrWebUnavailable`) the hub proceeds in-memory only.
- **TUI**: digest = hex(sha256(CanonicalRequest + "\x00" + InputFingerprint)) computed in `beginOperation` when a Confirmation exists and use cases implement the manager (internal/tui/app.go:232-254); Existing renders non-running result "matching durable operation already exists".
- **CLI**: `beginDurableCLICommand` wraps runtime-backed commands (flow, verify, execute, review, smoke, qa start/resume, study start/resume/task-analysis/task-synthesis) with `AcceptOperation(ctx, Confirmation{Request: request}, "")` — empty digest, so no alias row and no dedup (durable_operations.go:49-60; inventory pinned by run_control_inventory_test.go). - **Landing**: all three converge on `repository.Accept(Acceptance{Target:{Kind:"operation", Operation:string(kind), Project, Sprint, Study, Stage, Task}, ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (durable_operations.go:97-115). After accept: Claim with OwnerLeaseDuration, lifecycle-running event (failure proposes persistence_lost terminal), ownership {repository, fence} into the operation context, control goroutine started (durable_operations.go:116-137).

## 5. Cancellation semantics (per-door divergence)

- Browser hub path: canonicalCancelReason folds arbitrary input to {server_shutdown, timeout, recovery, else user_request} (operations.go:625-632); handlers pass literal "user_request" (operation_handlers.go:207, 390); drain passes "server_shutdown" (:490). Note spelling differs from the CLI/TUI family ("user_request" vs "user_requested").
- Browser durable fallback + TUI: "user_requested" (operation_handlers.go:209, 392; tui/app.go:110, 124).
- CancelQA use case: "read-only QA cancellation requested" (sprint_usecases.go:731), gated by membership check: snapshot Target.Project/Sprint must equal request and Target.Operation ∈ {qa-start, qa-resume}, else "QA run does not belong to the selected sprint" (:716-737).
- CLI `run cancel --reason`: validated against {user_requested, operator_requested, shutdown_requested, quota_exceeded}, default user_requested (run_commands.go:201-216, 394-401).

## 7. Trust boundaries

- Same logical action arriving via different doors must produce equivalent durable semantics (assignment framing): kind string, Target fields, and lifecycle writes are shared; identity entering the alias differs by design — web binds to (session, token) [per-browser anti-double-submit], TUI binds to content (canonical+fingerprint), CLI binds to nothing (every invocation its own run).
- Caller-supplied ExpectedFingerprint is stripped twice (prepare entry :215; RunOperation :377-378) and re-issued server-side; stale detection compares fresh fingerprint after re-hash of governed inputs.
- Identifier admission is layered: transport-level validOptionalIdentifier (web), validateOperationScope ([A-Za-z0-9._-] etc.), QA field lockdown enforced at both transport (mapOperationRequest) and app (validateQAOperationRequest) layers.
- Fingerprinting rejects symlinks anywhere in governed inputs and hashes with relative-path separators; missing files skipped (TOCTOU between hashing and execution is inherent to the mechanism).
- Sanitization boundary into durable/display data: displaySafe (app) for findings/errors/projections; payload whitelisting/bounding in RecordOperationEvent (durable_operations.go:182-195) and runtimeEventDraft (run_control.go:417-545, sensitive-key denylist, 30-key cap, bounded values); safeWebText redaction for web projections; safe command/event-name allowlists.
- Cancellation authority: repository validates reason format only; membership/ownership semantics are per-door policy (§5).
- Hub session model: signed cookie session + CSRF for API mutations; empty-session bypass exists for internal drain only.
